changelog: FIX: Resolved a logic issue where audio ducking would randomly interrupt and backgrounds sounds would prematurely return to default levels despite active communication.
FIX: Fixed a bug in the Audio Monitor where the name of the currently monitored application was not displaying correctly.
FIX: Fixed stability issues and eliminated critical bugs, significantly reducing potential application crashes during long-haul flights.
FIX: Resolved various minor bugs and optimized overall performance.
CHANGED: Implemented visual adjustments and UI refinements to enhance the interface's clarity.
CHANGED: Updated internal software libraries to ensure better compatibility with the latest Windows updates.
CHANGED: Refactored core components to minimize false positives in Windows Defender, which can occur due to the application's low-level integration with the Windows audio sub-system.
NEW: Added information and references regarding the launch of the new PRO version, which premieres alongside this 1.0.0 release.
